preconditions.description: Number of queries is between 1 and 100,000.
Order of the graph is between 1 and 1,000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= ai <= 10**16 for ai in a)
preconditions.description: Each vertex number ai in the queries is between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= bi <= 10**16 for bi in b)
preconditions.description: Each vertex number bi in the queries is between 1 and 10^16.

preconditions.expression: all(ai != bi for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
preconditions.description: ai and bi in each query are different.

preconditions.expression: all(ai <= abs_D_n and bi <= abs_D_n for ai, bi in zip(a, b))
preconditions.description: Both ai and bi in each query are less than or equal to the number of vertices in D(n).

postconditions.expression: all(isinstance(length, int) for length in lengths)
postconditions.description: Each output is an integer representing the length of the shortest path.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= length <= abs_D_n - 1 for length in lengths)
postconditions.description: The length of the shortest path is between 0 and the number of vertices minus one.
